answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 23869 Country: India Title: While offering salat of 4 rakats (faraz or sunnah), in the last two rakats should we have to say only surah fatiha or any other surah after it? Question: While offering salat of 4 rakats (faraz or sunnah),in the last two rakats should we have to say only surah fatiha or any other surah after it Answer ID: 23869 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1106/836/L=1431) Only Surah Fatiha shall be recited in the last two rakats of fardh salah. However it is wajib and necessary to add surah after surah fatiha in all the four rakats of nafl salah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
